summary: iter353c Unified Employee Accountability Timeline + HR Compliance Brief PDF fully verified. Backend pytest 22/22 PASS for the iter353c suite plus an additional 9/9 PASS in a new E2E RBAC+attribution test file. Frontend page renders with all 15 critical testids (header, 6 tiles, 7 tabs, PDF button); tab filtering math checks out (43 total = 1 training + 1 driver + 41 lifecycle); PDF download produces a valid binary PDF (%PDF- magic bytes, Content-Type application/pdf, suggested filename HR_Compliance_Brief_Alec_Perkins.pdf). All 3 entry points navigate correctly: HR Directory row link (hremp-acct-link-<id>) routes without opening the drawer (stopPropagation works), HR Drawer button (hremp-drawer-acct-link) routes correctly, Safety Profile (safety-emp-accountability-link) routes cross-portal and renders the HR-owned page. RBAC verified: anonymous browser sees a proper '403 Access Restricted' AccessDenied UI; PM/Shop/Dispatch/Field-Leadership tokens all return 401 from the backend. Cross-portal viewer.role attribution returns 'hr'/'safety'/'admin' correctly. Mobile 390 viewport shows zero horizontal overflow and rows render as cards (acct-card-*). Only minor concern: ES locale tile labels still show English uppercase text (CDL HOLDER / APPROVED DRIVER / EXPIRING ≤90D / EXPIRED) — the i18n keys for these labels do not appear to be registered yet. The problem statement explicitly accepted this (only flagged a leak if the key IS registered).

issues: Tile labels (CDL HOLDER, APPROVED DRIVER, CDL EXPIRES, MEDICAL CARD, EXPIRING ≤90D, EXPIRED) remain in English when locale=es. Tab labels also unchanged. i18n keys not yet wired for these copy strings. Problem statement permits this if keys aren't registered.

action_items: (Optional polish) Register i18n keys for the 6 status tile labels and 7 timeline tab labels so the page localizes when locale=es. Currently the strings render uppercase English in ES mode.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-role inline auth check (isHr() || isSafety() || isAdmin()) in HrEmployeeAccountabilityTimeline.jsx works correctly for the 3 allowed roles and falls through to the standard AccessDenied/sign-in UI for everyone else (verified anonymous flow).

Cross-portal nav from Safety -> /hr/employees/.../accountability is a hard route change to an HR-prefixed path; relies on Safety token being present in localStorage and the inline isSafety() check picking it up. This worked in the live browser flow.

Row-click vs link-click separation in HR Directory: stopPropagation on hremp-acct-link-<id> correctly prevents the drawer from opening when the user clicks the inline Accountability link. Confirmed in browser test (drawer testid count = 0 after direct link click).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all 11 listed acceptance items (ES minor caveat noted, expressly allowed by spec)
